# `/workflow-executions` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /workflow-executions/v1/{id}

`getWorkflowExecutionV1` — Get workflow execution

Use this API to get a single workflow execution. Workflow executions are available for up to 90 days before being archived. If you attempt to access a workflow execution that has been archived, you will receive a "404 Not Found" response.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execution:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Workflow execution ID.
- Returns 200: object

### GET /workflow-executions/v1/{id}/history

`getWorkflowExecutionHistoryV1` — Get workflow execution history

Get a detailed history of a single workflow execution. Workflow executions are available for up to 90 days before being archived. If you attempt to access a workflow execution that has been archived, you will receive a 404 Not Found.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execution:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow execution
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of workflowexecutionevent

### GET /workflow-executions/v1/{id}/history-v2

`getWorkflowExecutionHistoryV2ForV1` — Get updated workflow execution history

Gets a workflow execution history, trigger input, and workflow definition of a single workflow execution. Workflow executions are available for up to 90 days before being archived. If you attempt to access a workflow execution that has been archived, you will receive a 404 Not Found.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execution:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Id of the workflow execution
- Returns 200: workflowexecutionhistory

### POST /workflow-executions/v1/{id}/cancel

`cancelWorkflowExecutionV1` — Cancel workflow execution by id

Use this API to cancel a running workflow execution.

- Scopes: sp:workflow-execute:external
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The workflow execution ID
- Returns 204: no body
